data.name: Siddesh
data.gender_notes: Siddesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is the Lord of the Gods, the controller of all. Siddesh is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the word 'Sidh', which means accomplished, and 'Desh' which means land or realm. It is believed that this name represents the supreme being and the one who has achieved everything. The name Siddesh carries the meaning “Lord of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Siddesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the supreme deity and the ultimate goal of spiritual realization.
data.etymology: Siddesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Siddesh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
